businessGoal: To provide users with a way to sort products for improved navigation and usability.

scenarios.goal: Verify the sort dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that the sort dropdown includes the correct options: Name (A - Z), Name (Z - A), Price (High - Low), Price (Low - High).
Verify that selecting a sort option reloads the product grid with products ordered according to the selected sort.

manual.reason: The story involves visible UI elements and user interactions.

api.reason: No API interactions are mentioned in the story for sorting functionality.

ui.reason: Acceptance criteria clearly describe UI behavior and interactions with sorting.
